prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
competitors_mentioned: Palm Beach Tan at the Providence–Arboretum location
answer_verbatim:
If you mean a **sunless spray tan**, **Gorgeous GLO Beauty Bar** looks like a strong pick: it has positive feedback for helpful color matching and smooth, natural-looking results, and one review aggregator reports a 4.9 average. [Gorgeous GLO](https://www.gorgeousglo.com/)

For **UV tanning beds**, **Palm Beach Tan at the Providence–Arboretum location** is a reasonable option, with a listed 4.56 rating across 72 reviews. [Location details](https://palmbeachtan.com/locations/nc/charlotte-providence-arboretum)

“Best” depends on whether you want a spray tan or UV beds, and ratings can change—check recent reviews and pricing before booking. UV tanning also increases skin-cancer and premature-aging risk; a sunless tan avoids UV exposure.
